description: A utility class for managing configuration properties within the OpenMRS platform, providing methods to retrieve global, runtime, and system properties with a caching mechanism.

classes.name: ConfigUtil
classes.description: A utility class for working with configuration properties, implementing the GlobalPropertyListener interface to maintain a cache of global property values.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a global property, utilizing an internal cache to optimize repeated lookups.

methods.name: getRuntimeProperty
methods.description: Returns the value of a runtime property from the current context.

methods.name: hasRuntimeProperty
methods.description: Checks if a runtime property is defined.

methods.name: getSystemProperty
methods.description: Fetches the value of a system property from the Java system properties.

methods.name: hasSystemProperty
methods.description: Checks if a system property is defined.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Returns the value of a configuration property with precedence order: system, runtime, then global.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Returns the property value or a default if the property is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates the cache when a global property is changed.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Removes a property from the cache when it is deleted.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Indicates if this listener supports a given property name.
